meta.title: Project Signal: metrics to COPS network (target state)
meta.note: Target state. Metrics marked built exist today in signal_metrics.py; metrics marked hypothetical are assumed built so the whole network can be seen. Every metric is computed once, deterministically. COPS only read metrics and interpret them.

feasibility_legend.derivable_now: can be computed now from fields already collected
feasibility_legend.new_script: needs a new deterministic script over existing data
feasibility_legend.new_telemetry: needs telemetry that is not collected today

cop_status_legend.next: switched on after the first three

metric_state_meaning.UNKNOWN: could have happened but could not be seen

response_schema.interpretation: one label from the COP's own list
response_schema.action: NONE | WATCH | ALERT | INSTRUCT | REQUEST_CONTEXT | REQUEST_APPROVAL | PASS_TO_COP | ESCALATE | PAUSE | BLOCK
response_schema.driving_metrics: the metrics that most drove the reading
response_schema.downstream: COPS the finding is passed to
response_schema.limits: PAUSE and BLOCK are recommended only; every run is dry-run today

cops.name: Workflow Orchestration
cops.question: Is the task progressing coherently toward its intended state?

example_response.action_reason: no progress for several turns with plan items open

cops.name: Runtime Monitoring
cops.question: Is the evidence required for this governance decision present, reliable and sufficiently complete?

example_response.action_reason: findings stand but rest on partial evidence

cops.name: Anomaly Detection
cops.question: Is the observed behaviour materially different from what is expected in this context?

example_response.action_reason: deviation 8.0 on insights.token_outlier; unusual is not prohibited

cops.name: Context & Memory
cops.question: Is the current context internally consistent, relevant to the task, and supported by useful precedent?

cops.name: Interaction Discovery
cops.question: Who or what is interacting with whom, through what route, and how is the activity propagating?

example_response.action_reason: new edge to an MCP server never used by this operator

cops.name: Incident Response
cops.question: Do the current findings constitute an actionable incident, and what should happen now?

example_response.action_reason: unusual behaviour in a session that also reached credentials

cops.name: Classification & Tagging
cops.question: What kind of governance event is this, and which entities should remain associated with it?

example_response.action_reason: tagged boundary, credential; kept associated with operator and repo

cops.name: Policy Enforcement
cops.question: Does the observed behaviour violate an explicit permission, policy, entitlement, boundary, or approval requirement?

example_response.action_reason: sensitive path touched with no approval in session

cops.name: Risk Mitigation
cops.question: Do the combined findings create a material or emerging risk, and what residual risk remains after available controls?

example_response.action_reason: secret read followed by a network step with no restore point

cops.name: Resource Management
cops.question: Is resource consumption within entitlement and acceptable operating bounds?

example_response.action_reason: consumption far above the estate norm with subagents fanned out

cops.name: Governance Intelligence
cops.question: What recurring patterns, concentrations or blind spots indicate a broader governance problem?

example_response.action_reason: most unattributed changes come from two operators

cops.name: Behavior Analytics
cops.question: What behavioural pattern best characterizes this execution or sequence of executions?

example_response.action_reason: same call repeated in one lane with no change between

cops.name: Recovery & Resilience
cops.question: After failure or intervention, did the system return to a viable state without compounding the problem?

example_response.action_reason: rollback restored files but a push had already gone out

cops.name: Workload Optimization
cops.question: Is the workload using tools, models, time and resources efficiently for the task being performed?

example_response.action_reason: the same files read again with nothing changed

cops.name: Audit & Traceability
cops.question: Can every consequential finding, decision and action be attributed and reconstructed from trustworthy evidence?

example_response.action_reason: two findings cannot be traced to a raw event

cops.name: Knowledge & Policy Management
cops.question: Are the rules, policies and governance knowledge currently being used still current, coherent and internally consistent?

example_response.action_reason: a deny rule hit often on ordinary work and was overridden

cops.name: Agent Lifecycle Management
cops.question: Has an agent's identity, version, configuration, capability or connectivity changed in a way requiring governance attention?

example_response.action_reason: same operator now on a new machine with a new tool version

cops.name: Governance Architecture
cops.question: Does the current governance architecture adequately cover the estate and the behaviours actually occurring?

example_response.action_reason: no tool in the estate can show whether approvals were asked
